items.name: Individual remedy
items.text: Example: a household is denied an existing ration entitlement. The expected result is a lawful case decision, correction or reasoned refusal and a usable appeal. A public debate must not delay an available individual remedy.
items.example: a household is denied an existing ration entitlement
items.expectedResult: a lawful case decision, correction or reasoned refusal and a usable appeal
items.note: A public debate must not delay an available individual remedy.

items.name: Systemic review
items.text: Example: repeated authentication failures prevent access to a public scheme. The expected result is evidence gathering, affected-person participation, alternative designs, a decision and an implementation review.
items.example: repeated authentication failures prevent access to a public scheme
items.expectedResult: evidence gathering, affected-person participation, alternative designs, a decision and an implementation review

items.name: Policy or law
items.text: Example: extend portable voting or require public hearings. The expected result is a consultation, explicit tradeoffs, a reasoned institutional response and the appropriate rule-making or legislative process. A poll does not create legal authority.
items.example: extend portable voting or require public hearings
items.expectedResult: a consultation, explicit tradeoffs, a reasoned institutional response and the appropriate rule-making or legislative process
items.note: A poll does not create legal authority.

caveat: Immediate safety threats need appropriate emergency or protection services. This project is not an emergency responder. Filing here must not make people miss statutory appeal or litigation deadlines.
